body: Claiming B-2026-08-15-12. Hypothesis: the classify-only init rebuild (initialization.py) + loop.py's early-return branches for is_direct/is_clarification already satisfy the backlog's (a) prompt-tune tier-2->direct and (b) proportionate direct-mode reasoning -- confirming by reading loop.py in full before assuming. The unfinished piece per the 2026-09-15 research doc is (c): a regression test proving direct/clarify turns never emit workspace/loop events (mark_turn_start, todo_*, tool_call obs) while execute turns do. Plan: read loop.py's branch structure fully, then add regression coverage (likely a new test module alongside tests/core/test_agent_initialization.py) asserting on the obs-event stream per mode. Will only touch initialization.py/loop.py if the read surfaces a real gap, not just to add tests.
